💡 Mailspring | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A desktop email client that provides a fast, efficient, and extensible way to manage email across multiple accounts on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
✨ Key Features: • Unified Inbox • Snooze • Send Later • Mail Rules • Templates
📖 Summary: Mailspring is a fast, open-source email client for Windows, macOS, and Linux, built with TypeScript, Electron, and React. It features a C++ sync engine for improved performance and reduced resource usage compared to its predecessor, Nylas Mail. The client offers a plugin architecture for extensibility and includes features like a unified inbox, snooze, send later, and mail rules.
